title: AETH-01 RunPod canary receipt
description: Enforced shape of receipt.json written by run_canary.py. A receipt missing any required field, with status != "PASS", or with cases_matched != cases_run, is a failed/incomplete canary regardless of what run_canary.py printed to stdout. `status` is the single authoritative pass/fail signal (run_canary.py's own process exit code is 0 iff status == "PASS"); cases_matched == cases_run alone is NOT sufficient, since status can be FAIL_ENVIRONMENT or FAIL_INCOMPLETE with zero cases run.

backend.description: numpy_fallback on an actual GPU pod is itself a finding (CuPy failed to import) and forces status=FAIL_ENVIRONMENT unless AETH01_CANARY_REQUIRE_GPU=0 (local smoke-test only) -- never a silent PASS.

status.description: Closed vocabulary, the single authoritative verdict. FAIL_INCOMPLETE is the placeholder written before the run starts -- it must never be reinterpreted as a pass; finding it on disk means the run did not reach a verdict (e.g. killed by watchdog.sh).

cases_run.description: 0 is valid only when status is FAIL_ENVIRONMENT or FAIL_INCOMPLETE (the corpus never ran).

single_tick_trials.description: Preregistered single-tick trial count (TRIALS in run_canary.py).

multi_tick_steps.description: Ticks compared per multi-tick trajectory (MULTI_TICK_STEPS); cases_run = single_tick_trials + sum over multi-tick trajectories of (ticks compared up to first divergence, capped at multi_tick_steps).

rng_seed.description: Fixed preregistered seed (RNG_SEED) the trial corpus was drawn from.

gpu_kernel_seconds.description: Informational throughput comparison only, not itself a pass/fail gate.

mismatches.description: Empty on success. Never silently dropped: each entry is the full CPU/GPU input state that disagreed, including which tick of a multi-tick trajectory it was.

started_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, written before the corpus runs.

finished_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the final verdict; null only in the FAIL_INCOMPLETE placeholder.

source_hashes.description: sha256 hex digest of each bundled physics/harness source file actually present on the pod, so a reviewer can confirm which revision ran without needing git history there (the image only ever contains a copy, not a checkout).

cost_context.description: Echo of launch_pod.sh's cost-control inputs for this run, if it set them; all null when run standalone (e.g. local smoke test).

error.description: Present only when status == FAIL_ERROR: repr() of the unhandled exception.
